gate-head.sh runs pytest directly in the shared worktree and neither the script nor gate-head.log names an all_debug job or an unset SLURM_JOB_ID, so the done_when clause 'as a job on all_debug with SLURM_JOB_ID unset' is unrecorded; the head pass itself holds at e3ba8d62 and over main's tree in landing-arm-repaired.log.

the exemption compares every positional argument of a removal call with the registration's path expression rather than the argument the removal helper actually frees, so a future body that registers its own tree and frees a handed path while passing the registered target in another positional slot is dropped from the scan silently; no current caller has that shape and the four controls at :438-477 cover only the keyword-option and handed-path cases.

rubric.cleanliness reports a clean ruff check on the changed test file, but ruff check reports I001 on its import block at both 42fe90d0 and e3ba8d62, so the file is not clean; the accurate claim is that the commit adds no finding, which is what the identical base result shows.
